scope: To characterize novel molecules that interact with mutant JAK2, we employed a combination of co-immunoprecipitation and mass spectrometry analysis.

Both K562 wild-type (WT) JAK2-expressing cells and HEL cells expressing mutant JAK2 were lysed, and anti-JAK2 or IgG immunoprecipitation was performed to recover JAK2 molecules along with their associated factors (the JAK2 complex). Mass spectrometry analysis of peptides specifically associated with mutant JAK2 identified DESI2 as the top candidate within the JAK2-V617F complex
Detailed information on the proteomic analysis of JAK2 complexes via co-immunoprecipitation and mass spectrometry is provided in the Supporting Information.
